checkedAlternates.risk: Flaps are movable surfaces on the wing like ailerons.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Flaps are secondary high-lift devices for takeoff/landing (group-2), not primary roll/pitch/yaw axis controls (group-3).

checkedAlternates.risk: Trim tabs are attached to primary control surfaces.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Trim tabs relieve control-stick pressure rather than commanding primary maneuvers (group-4).
